entries.clue: What Up All Night was, back in 2011

factCards.text: Five studio albums appeared in five consecutive years: Up All Night in 2011, Take Me Home in 2012, Midnight Memories in 2013, Four in 2014 and Made in the A.M. in 2015.
Up All Night entered the Billboard 200 at number one in March 2012, the first debut album by a British group to do so.
factCards.sourceTitle: Billboard 200 chart archive, week of 31 March 2012

factCards.text: Made in the A.M. arrived in November 2015 and was the first album released after the group had become a four-piece.
